'''Trig''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Chief/Legends|chief]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] reconstruction forces on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He reported to [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Leontyne Saresh]] on the effect that the [[Rakghoul]]s were having on his team's efforts.<ref name="TOR" />
